subject: Org admin seeding & API provisioning roadmap — Ares Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@areshealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@areshealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0000
Subject: Org admin seeding & API provisioning roadmap — Ares Health

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m kicking off the implementation sequence for Ares Health’s initial tenant: admin seeding, API key provisioning, and role mapping. I attached a short seed plan and a role-mapping CSV that should make the first pass easy for your IT and security team to review.

High-level proposal (short):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm admin list & MFA requirement; exchange onboarding contact and preferred maintenance windows.
- Week 1: Seed admin accounts (3 admin users), create initial project namespaces, generate scoped API keys for sandbox.
- Week 2: Run integration smoke tests, hand over monitoring dashboards, and schedule a 30-minute walkthrough.
- Week 3: Promote keys to prod-like project if smoke tests pass; finalize role bindings and rotate admin invite links.

Action items for you: Please confirm the three admin recipients (full name + corporate email) and whether Ares requires HSM-backed keys or KMS. If HSM is required, flag that now so we can route to our private deployment team.

Attachments: initial-seed-plan.xlsx, api-key-seed-instructions.pdf, role-mapping-template.csv

I’ll start the invite seeding once I have the confirmed admin list and maintenance window.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
---
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@areshealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@areshealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 13:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Org admin seeding & API provisioning roadmap — Ares Health

Aditya —

Thanks for the note. Sounds good overall. Quick answers:
- Admins (initial three): Alex Carter <alex.carter@areshealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@areshealth.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@areshealth.com>.
- We require KMS for keys; HSM is not necessary at this stage but we will want the option later.
- Preferred maintenance window: Tue/Wed 18:00–20:00 ET for any disruptive actions.

One question: can you confirm the expiry/rotation policy you’ll use for the sandbox-scoped API keys? Also, our security team requested your SOC 2 scope and evidence for audit — is there a direct doc we can share?

Best,
Alex
Head of Integrations, Ares Health
---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@areshealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@areshealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2028 15:24:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Org admin seeding & API provisioning roadmap — Ares Health

Alex —

Perfect — thanks for the admins and window. Quick answers inline and updated plan below.

- Key rotation/expiry: For sandbox keys we create scoped API keys with a 90-day expiry and recommend rotation every 30–60 days for active keys. For production scopes we recommend 30-day rotation with automated reminders; we can enforce rotation via our policy if you want.
- SOC 2: attaching a pointer below to our auditor bundle (redacted) and the SOC 2 Type II scope document. I’ve also added the security questionnaire stub to the Drive link for you to populate.

Updated timeline (ET maintenance windows in mind):
- Wed 17 Jul (night window): Seed admin invites (Alex, Priya, Marcus) and provision sandbox project + 3 scoped API keys.
- Mon 22 Jul: Integration smoke tests (Dev will run test harness and share logs).
- Wed 24 Jul: Walkthrough (20 minutes) to confirm dashboards and key usage.
- Fri 26 Jul: If smoke tests pass, promote to prod-like project and set rotation policy.

I’ve started the invite flow — you’ll see an invite email from invites@redwood.ai. Monica will own the admin seed and Stephanie will schedule the walkthrough. Dev will coordinate the smoke-test plan.

Attachments: SOC2-typeII-redacted.pdf (drive link), see hubspot deal links

Thanks,
Aditya
---

Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@areshealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org admin seeding & API provisioning roadmap — Ares Health

Quick technical note for the seed:
- For sandbox-scoped keys I’ll generate tokens limited to the "sandbox" project namespace with token metadata that restricts endpoints to generation and embeddings only (no admin endpoints).
- I recommend enabling prefix K/V caching for the sandbox to speed up dev cycle tests; minimal config change.
- If Ares opts into KMS-only keys, we’ll use customer-managed keys and provide an encrypted-import flow; that adds ~2 business days to the timeline.

Monica / Aditya — I can run the smoke harness in the Tue/Wed window. I’ll attach the smoke test checklist to the Drive folder.

—Dev

From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@areshealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Alex Carter <alex.carter@areshealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 16:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Org admin seeding & API provisioning roadmap — Ares Health

Thanks team —

We confirm the Tue/Wed 18:00–20:00 ET window for any disruptive activity. KMS-only is acceptable for now; please treat HSM as a future requirement. We reviewed the role-mapping template — a couple of clarifying asks:

- Can you add a row for a non-admin "Monitoring Viewer" role with read-only dashboard access and request-scoped logs export?
- For rotation policy please send a short one-page doc we can circulate to our security team.

We received invites from invites@redwood.ai and Alex accepted. Please proceed with sandbox seeding Wed night and share the smoke-test checklist. Also, thank you for the SOC 2 pointer — our audit lead will reach out if they need anything redacted further.

Best,
Priya Menon
IT Security Lead, Ares Health
